summary: FD_TC_180_Duplicate Claim � Different Claimant, Same Passenger Already Compensated
title: Duplicate Claim � Different Claimant, Same Passenger Already Compensated
description:
A different person (e.g., travel agent, spouse) files a claim for a passenger who was already compensated on a previous claim filed by the passenger themselves. System detects that the PASSENGER has already been compensated even though the CLAIMANT is different. Validates that duplicate detection is passenger-based, not claimant-based.

Prerequisites:
PNR: 2 passengers (Catherine Bouchard + Marc Bouchard), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Original claim: Catherine filed for herself, $400 paid. Second claim: Marc Bouchard files a new claim and includes Catherine as a passenger to claim for. Duplicate indicators: Catherine's passenger record already has compensation paid on original case. Marc's claim for himself is NEW (not duplicate).
